faqs.question: What products are available in the optical shop?
faqs.answer: We provide eyeglasses, sunglasses, contact lenses, frames, eye care accessories, and vision testing services.

faqs.question: Do you provide eye testing services?
faqs.answer: Yes, professional eye testing and vision check-up services are available.

faqs.question: How can I book an eye test appointment?
faqs.answer: Appointments can be booked through phone call, website, WhatsApp, or direct visit.

faqs.question: Can I do an eye test without appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes, walk-in eye tests are accepted depending on doctor availability.

faqs.question: How long does an eye test take?
faqs.answer: An eye test usually takes around 15 to 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Do you provide prescription glasses?
faqs.answer: Yes, prescription eyeglasses are available based on your eye power.

faqs.question: What types of frames are available?
faqs.answer: We offer metal, plastic, rimless, full-frame, half-frame, and branded frame options.

faqs.question: What types of lenses are available?
faqs.answer: Single vision, bifocal, progressive, blue-cut, anti-glare, and photochromic lenses are available.

faqs.question: Do you sell contact lenses?
faqs.answer: Yes, daily, monthly, colored, and prescription contact lenses are available.

faqs.question: Can you help me choose contact lenses?
faqs.answer: Yes, our staff can help you choose suitable contact lenses based on your prescription and comfort.

faqs.question: Do you sell sunglasses?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide regular, polarized, UV-protected, and branded sunglasses.

faqs.question: Do you have glasses for children?
faqs.answer: Yes, special frames and lenses for kids are available.

faqs.question: Do you provide computer or blue-light glasses?
faqs.answer: Yes, blue-light protection glasses for computer and mobile usage are available.

faqs.question: Can I customize my glasses?
faqs.answer: Yes, frame and lens customization options are available.

faqs.question: How long does it take to make glasses?
faqs.answer: Delivery time depends on lens type and frame selection, usually within a few days.

faqs.question: Do you provide urgent or same-day delivery?
faqs.answer: Same-day delivery may be available for selected frames and lenses.

faqs.question: Do you repair eyeglasses?
faqs.answer: Yes, frame adjustments and minor repairs are available.

faqs.question: Can I replace lenses in my old frame?
faqs.answer: Yes, lenses can be replaced if the frame condition is suitable.

faqs.question: Do you provide glasses cleaning services?
faqs.answer: Yes, cleaning and maintenance services are available.

faqs.question: Do glasses come with warranty?
faqs.answer: Warranty availability depends on the brand and product type.

faqs.question: Can I return or exchange glasses?
faqs.answer: Exchange or return policies depend on the product and store terms.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept cash, cards, UPI, and online payments.

faqs.question: Do you accept insurance claims?
faqs.answer: Insurance support may be available depending on provider policies.

faqs.question: Do you have offers or discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes, seasonal discounts and promotional offers may be available.

faqs.question: Do you sell branded eyewear?
faqs.answer: Yes, branded frames and sunglasses are available.

faqs.question: Do you provide home delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, home delivery may be available depending on location.

faqs.question: Can I order glasses online?
faqs.answer: Yes, selected products can be ordered online or through WhatsApp.

faqs.question: What are your shop timings?
faqs.answer: Shop timings vary depending on location and business hours.

faqs.question: Are you open on holidays?
faqs.answer: Holiday availability depends on the store schedule.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Parking facilities may be available depending on shop location.

faqs.question: How can I contact the optical shop?
faqs.answer: You can contact us through phone, WhatsApp, email, or direct visit.
